description.zh: Exchange所属的云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例的ID。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance to which the exchange belongs.
The maximum number of results to return.

description.zh: 用来标记当前查询结束的位置，以便下一次调用时作为参数传入，继续翻页。首次调用或返回最后一页时，取值为空字符串。
description.en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If this is your first call, or if you have retrieved all results, leave this parameter empty.
The name of the vhost to which the exchange belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun amqp-open list-down-stream-bindings --instance-id 1880770869023000 --virtual-host test --exchange-name test --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun amqp-open ListDownStreamBindings --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --InstanceId 1880770869023000 --MaxResults 1 --VirtualHost test --ExchangeName test
